ideas.name: TVL-to-market-cap weekly long-short DeFi tokens
ideas.claim: Rank coins weekly by TVL/market cap; long top 25%, short bottom 25%, value-weighted. Paper finds the long-short mean return is insignificant and alphas are insignificant.
ideas.quote: We then create a value-weighted long-short portfolio which buys the top 25% of coins by TVL and sells the bottom 25%.

rules.timeframe: weekly (rank on week t-1, return over week t)
rules.entry: long top quartile TVL/market cap, short bottom quartile

ideas.claimed_result: TVL HML mean about -0.14% per week, insignificantly different from 0; alphas insignificant across all TVL portfolios (weekly, Jan 2 2023 to Dec 31 2024)
